notes.title: 1.0.6 - Halloween Contents, Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hoochoo Game Studios brings you 1.0.6 release notes.

In this update, we've added some Halloween decorations and also focused on bug fixes and gameplay improvements.

In future updates, we promise to improve the English translation of the game and also to add more supported languages.

❗ macOS minimum system requirements is now version 10.13 instead of 10.12. If needed, please update your operating system.

🐛 1.0.7 Hotfix - Fixed cases where the customer thinks the player hid a card on the private slot when none was hidden.

- Release Notes
    
[h2]New Features[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37932204/da92f5b23200c50107db5ff4c694e167c29b28ab.gif[/img]

    ✨ Happy Halloween! Decorations have been placed all over Ajik City. You can also select "Dracula" for Hue's appearance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37932204/149ee28c3cfc2e33a38c017aaf2ad698c66b1341.gif[/img]

    ✨ Missed the dialogue? No worries now! We've added a log you can browse to check back what the customer was saying.
    
    ✨ You can now collect all the game endings! In the past, only major game endings, excluding minor endings and game overs, were collectible.
    
[h2]Improvements[/h2]
    
    🎨 Improved some parts of the tutorial for a more detailed explanation.
    
    🎨 To prevent players from getting stuck by spending too much money on their first day before the tutorial, players will be given their start money once they enter the store on day 1.
    
    🎨 Fixed some wrong item properties.
    
    🎨 Added a new path for players concerning the blackmailer, who may this time be "not so certain".
    
    🎨 Some street-view graphic layer orders have been fixed.
    
    🐛 Fixed the invisible calendar button being able to be clicked in the street view.
    
    🐛 Fixed the calendar not showing the overlay properly.
    
[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
    
    ❗ We're working on an English translation overhaul. Please stay tuned!
    
    ❗ We're working on cases where the mouse disappears during the game. This may have been fixed by this update, but we're keeping our eyes on this issue.
    
    ❗ We're working on cases where players can get stuck in the flower shop in the challenge mode. This may have been fixed by this update, but we're keeping our eyes on this issue.
    
    ⚠️ Checking on graphic glitches in the street view
    
    ⚠️ Trying to fix cases where the player can fall of the elevator
    
    ⚠️ Working on a case where the bonus extra slot for the auction is not being applied correctly.
    
    ⚠️ Some UI elements in the tutorial are not fully translated.

notes.title: 1.0.0 - No Umbrellas Allowed
notes.content:
Hoochoo Game Studios brings you 1.0.0 release notes. We would like to give huge thanks to everyone for giving us invaluable feedback and support during the early access period.

- 1.0 Release Notes

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37932204/727d85196275ec9d2a9810356effad90cce322fb.gif[/img]
✨ Even more street events! Ever wondered what the characters have been doing in their spare time?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37932204/905dbccba59dc1f9f37f1dfb31583da3263572f1.gif[/img]
✨ Residents of Junuk side and Sing Sing side appear as new types of visitors. Please welcome guests from two very different neighborhoods.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37932204/a0df32afa2756a0e00f3259fbfbf7b111f9ba0fc.gif[/img]
✨ You can finally ride a hoverboard! If you venture into the streets, you may find the hoverboard merchant.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37932204/dd0cdcafb82d40641f26d2f5aa777e2549e003e2.gif[/img]
✨ The bus rides between Sing Sing side and Junuk Side just got an exciting graphics upgrade.

✨ The flower shop, repair shop, and auction house are now available in Challenge Mode. Steam leaderboard functionality has also been added to the Challenge Mode results window. Compete with your friends and see who scores highest!

✨ A new "Updated Items" page has been added to the manual. Information that changes over time will be shown here.

✨ More background music and sound effects have been added. You can also hear the lovely Gillian purring!

✨ After the game's ending credits and cookies, you'll be shown some fun facts about your gameplay.

✨ Ending illustrations can now be collected and viewed in the start menu.

[h2]Improvements[/h2]

❗ Fixed a bug where some interaction event trigger can erroneously cause other events to play.

❗ Fixed an error where customers were accepting a wrong card after the SAS brand update event.

❗ Fixed being able to use the pardon earned by donating to AVAC all week long.

🎨 The price and probability have been adjusted to ensure that there are more benefits available from the auction house.

🎨 We have changed the conditions under which the auction house will be available. You can use it if you choose the items that the club members are looking for.

🎨 The number and effect of the reputation card already attached to the item now move together according to the store's current reputation changes.

🎨 If the repair shop fixes the item, the production sound effect has been added.

🎨 Sound effects have been added when customers put down their items and put them on the display case.

🎨 I've made it possible to donate more times a day to overfeeds.

🎨 Many English translations have been corrected more naturally.

🎨 Character Outline has naturally improved.

🐛 As soon as I entered the gameplay, I came to the start screen and fixed the black screen.

🐛 We have made sure that the camera does not move out of the screen incorrectly.

🐛 Some icons have been incorrectly placed in the manual and have been fixed.

🐛 Improved rain bouncing effect particles downstairs.

🐛 If you press a certain section in the air on the street, the bug that opens the calendar has been fixed.

🐛 Some of the past flash cuts have been corrected for incorrect English translations.

🐛 Fixed the fact that the items left for repair were still in the display case.

🐛 The appearance of Guafiyeon has been corrected to pay a fine every day when displaying umbrellas.

🐛 The recommendation box disappeared from the challenge mode and the application of the recommendation card internally was corrected.

🐛 Some endings have fixed the white background.

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]

🐙 "State card changing after purchasing an item" is not a bug but the effect of the "Adam" flower you bought at the flower shop. The playful Adam magically makes things better or worse.

⚠️ Trying to fix cases where the mouse cursor goes missing.

notes.title: 0.11.7 - Bug Fixes, Steam Cloud Save
notes.content:
Hoochoo Game Studios brings you the 0.11.7 release notes. Please check below for more details.

[h2]Steam Cloud Save Files[/h2]

[strike]Starting today, we will now enable Steam auto-cloud, which syncs save files across devices. New saves will be synced, but already existing save files may not be included. Please refer to  Steam's cloud FAQ for more.

This problem may likely occur when steam cloud fails to sync on some computers. Please email us at support@hoochoogamestudios.com if you also have this problem. We'll see if there's anything else we can help you with.

notes.title: Survey event closed
notes.content:
Our survey event has been successfully finished! We greatly appreciate your support and interest. Our team is going through all the answers and requests, and we’re also looking forward that the play data that came along with the survey results will help us a lot to balance the game designs.
With the survey results, further developments that have been demanded by players are being discussed. The followings are what our team is currently planning to accomplish before the release.

- Story-less mode that only consists of appraising and haggling
- Balancing and re-improving rent-out system
- Developing after-game analysis
- Enabling collection of ending scenes

...and other improvements are under discussion.

Again, thank you for all the help and support. We ask for your continuous interest until the release!

notes.title: 0.10.4 - Better Feedbacks, Survey Event
notes.content:
In the last few patches, we introduced the reputation system and tried to give players the experience of continued growth by showing change indicators on the top bar. However, we realized that players found the constant rise and fall of reputation stressing and distracting. This, coupled with the lack of proper feedback on exactly what had gone wrong during the player's evaluation of the item, has led only to frustration. This patch tries to fix this issue.

First, we improved the way the customer gives feedback to the player so that the player can focus more naturally on the experience in a relaxed manner. The specificity of customer feedbacks will provide players with more straightforward hints on where they can improve, while point in time for the indication of changes in the reputation has been altered to be less distracting and more acceptable.

- Release Notes

[h2]New Features[/h2]

    ✨ Customers will provide much more detailed feedback about players' item appraisals. Players can now build upon various hints about where they could improve.

    ✨ The requirement for item recommendations is more flexible. An item with generally good cards will raise your "Recommended by Darcy's" reputation, while an item with generally bad cards will not.

    ✨ When an item in the inventory is changed, the item will now show an icon.

    ✨ When a card of an item in the inventory is changed, the card will be highlighted with an icon. A card with persistent effects or one that is potentially subject to change is also highlighted.

    ✨ In some events concerning items in the inventory, like at Hanja's JunkJunk or during a conversation with Bokho, relevant items are now highlighted in the inventory.

    ✨ "New" badges now highlight pages in the manual you have not visited yet.

    ✨ Added types of flowers with distinct effects, as well as a clearer visual indication as to when it's taking effect.

[h2]Improvements[/h2]

    ❗ Customers requesting rental will accept higher prices or make a reasonable counter-offer. Customers looking to rent items will now appear more later in the game.

    ❗ When a player makes a wrong evaluation of an item, customers will provide clearer and more relevant feedback.

    ❗ The speed at which store reputations rise, cases when they rise or fall, has all been improved to provide a more streamlined experience.

    ❗ "Appraised by Darcy's" reputation will now change not when buying an item but when selling. By doing so, players will now be given very clearly why their reputation is being hurt.

    🎨 The auction house will now be much more profitable.

    🎨 The auction house will now hold your item for two days before letting you attend its auction.

    🎨 Some graphics relating to events in Mindlesso have been added.

    🎨 Changed calculator behavior to clearly show "not enough balance" message.

    🐛 Fixed similar items spawning in groups.

    🐛 Fixed not being able to read the full text of cards.

    🐛 Fixed some cases where customers who want an item curated do not accept items they are supposed to accept.

    🐛 Fixed some cases where the game freezes when curating particular items.

    🐛 The repair shop and the auction house will provide a better reason for why they are turning down your items.

    🐛 Fixed some events showing in the evening square elevator when they're not supposed to.

    🐛 Fixed customers refusing cards from the jewel scan tool.

    🐛 Fixed some wrong masks in endings.

    🐛 Fixed some cases where customers offer a better deal than the player's suggestion.

    🐛 Fixed some cases where getting a loan results in wrong loan interest records being added to the calendar.

    🐛 Fixed a bug where despite moving to the penthouse, you're told to have failed to join the Fixie Pension if you have no active loan.

    🐛 Fixed cases where the IME input breaks the text input fields in the bug reporter.

    🐛 Fixed cases where some tool sprites are erroneously displayed.

    🐛 Fixed cases where holding tools or having a UI open while moving between scenes causes problems.

    🐛 Text overflow in the calendar is now properly masked and scrollable.

    🐛 When curating an item, added handling for cases where the player first curates an item but refuses to name a price.

    🐛 Fixed same umbrellas appearing multiple times, and creating a weird, state-sharing twin in the inventory. Furthermore, umbrellas will now spawn every week as intended.

    🐛 Fixed being able to dispose of an umbrella that is being fixed in the repair shop.

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]

    ⚠️ Some street NPC animations and events are malfunctioning and being fixed.

notes.title: 0.10.4 Released & Survey Event!
notes.content:
[h2]Survey Event[/h2]

With the release of 0.10.4, we are also starting a survey event. This patch brings lots of improvement to the appraisal feedback system and financial balance. We've spent much time and effort on bug fixes and tests. We apologize for the long wait on this update and promise to continue to work hard to improve the game.

Full details on the patch note can be found here:
[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1301390/view/3042721563410550340]0.10.4 Release Notes[/url][/h2]

In this version, we are conducting a survey in the credits scene after the game ends. 

Survey participants may also leave their address for a chance to receive thank-you gifts from us.
- Character photo cards
- Postal cards with graphic art

Unfortunately, only valid Korean addresses are eligible for entry to receive these gifts.
Even if you are playing outside of Korea, you can join the survey to help shape the game.

Please note that saves from previous versions will be hidden by default in the save load scene,
but can be found by unchecking the "Show only saves that can join the survey event".

notes.title: 0.10.0 - Balance, Quality of Life Improvements, and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[h2]New Features[/h2]

✨ Revamped rental system and added related events: The rental system has been modified overall, rental events will now unlock faster and the rental fee system has been changed. In addition, we have added new events related to rental success/failure.

✨ Story, Ending, and Accomplishments: Jane and her new story will begin on Day 23. In some cases, you may encounter related new endings and achievements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37932204/f1ec5f8c8223a55d665d5a333ff343b4258d3832.gif[/img]

✨ New Friday Nightmares: We've improved and changed the dreams Bob has every Friday until week 5. This will make the events related to the Blackmailer more involved and zstea

✨ Quick Reference Item Details Window: When selling or curating an item, the information of the related item is now automatically displayed. You won't have to open the inventory to check the price of an item every time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37932204/ca30455dee069a1b8704df1e98a4ab0ae07ed7d8.gif[/img]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]

❗ Improvements have been made in cases where the entire save graph is not visible when some save files fail to load on the Save Selection page.

❗ Fixed a bug that prevents subsequent events from occurring after purchasing conversations from the Citizen Chat Data Store.

❗ Fixed a bug that prevented repeated penalties for frequent use of the secret card slot from occurring repeatedly.

🎨 Dialogue in the street can now be fast-forwarded.

🎨 The mouse cursor image has been changed to make clickable UI elements more distinct.

🎨 Now the cost of repairing items in the repair shop varies depending on the item. Items repaired at the repair shop will also have the "Repaired" card added.

🎨 The lawyer will now offer assistance and come back with results after 

🎨 The speed of the plaza elevator has been increased.

🐛 At the auction house, items with the "Archeological Value" card have been fixed for too high a price and items with "domestic value" cards have been fixed for too low a bug has been fixed.

🐛 Improved the problem of not accepting items for the man who asks for the most expensive item in the store.

🐛 Fixed a bug that prevented at least one umbrella coming into the store every week during early game.

🐛 Fixed a bug that miscalculates the appraised price of some items.

🐛 A bug has been fixed where the auction house's fee calculation was incorrect.

🐛 Fixed a bug where customers may ask for a higher price than the display price.

🐛 Fixed quickly consecutive pressing of calculator buttons not registering properly.

🐛 Fixed a bug where the item picked up from the trash does not appear in inventory.

🐛 Fixed case where incompatible saves from older version cannot be deleted.

🐛 Fixed a case where an item that should not be able to be sold can be sold.

🐛 Fixed the repair shop not correcting the condition card of an item.

🐛 Quickly clicking repeatedly on clothes and hair purchase buttons will no longer trigger multiple purchases.

🐛 Fixed positioning of the slider showing % progress in the Reputation UI.

🐛 If the square elevator is available, moving to the opposite side using the bus will now move the elevator to move to the player's position so that the player won't fall below the map.

🐛 Fixed cases where the junk shop claims only one item can be disposed, no matter how many items can actually be disposed.

🐛 The UI elements have been rearranged to ensure that the contents that were obscured are visible correctly.

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]

⚠️We are solving the issue where similar items will come into the store in groups during late game.

⚠️ Customers are not giving feedback as much as they should about the wrong cards on the item they are buying.

notes.title: 0.9.9 - Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hoochoo Game Studios brings you 0.9.9 patch notes.

We are focusing on fixing bugs and improving late game.

We are listening hard to your bug reports and feedbacks, for which we are always grateful. We apologize for not being able to respond to all posts. We will work harder to respond to your posts.

[h2]New Features[/h2]

🎨 More events after day 25.

We heard a lot of feedback that players feel late game as being monotonous. So, we are adding more events during that period. We will continue to improve this part right up until our 1.0 launch.

🎨 More ways to dispose umbrellas.

Another option to dispose umbrellas, instead of forcedly giving it up to AVAC, has been added.

🎨 The '~' key now closes the manual when the manual is open on the table of contents page.

🎨 You can now toggle open and close the reputation status panel with the 'R' key.

[h2]Improvements[/h2]

🐛 Fixed hair / clothes unlock, and bugs in other stores

Fixed an error where new hair and clothes are not unlocked. Fixed Hanja saying only one item being able to disposed when there are many at JunkJunk.

🐛 Fixed some erroneous item data, including Chirplight products slogan.

Chirplights had their slogans wrong despite being a genuine item, making the brand appraisal confusing. This has now been fixed, along with other minor errors with other item designs. Validating all items is currently an ongoing process.

🐛 Fixed "Recommended by Darcy's" reputation

We got a lot of feedback that the "Recommended by Darcy's" reputation does not rise above 30%. After looking into the issue, we decided to remove one part of the requirement for level up.

🐛 Fixed the last slot in the display case not working correctly.

🐛 Fixed an issue where the Auction store was not calculating the commission fee as stated.

🐛 Fixed cases where some brand detail pages had the order of the materials wrong.

🐛 Fixed cases where customers tried to underprice the items for being scribbled on when there is no signature at all.

🐛 Fixed cases where items can be purchased for 0V.

notes.title: 0.9.7 - Better Font, Usability Improvements, and Temporary Workaround for Bugs
notes.content:
Hoochoo Game Studios brings you 0.9.7 release notes.

Customers buying item from the shop will now give hints about the wrong appraisals you made.

A new font has been applied for better readability. Also, text will appear sharper across multiple resolutions and screen ratios.

A relevant manual page will pop up automatically when you are looking into an item with the Appraisal tool. Useful quick links have been added to some manual pages, providing ease of navigation.

We are putting our best effort into improving gameplay, financial balance, and, most of all, fixing bugs. We apologize sincerely for some cases where gameplay is rough and buggy. We promise to continue improving the game. We have outlined some of the bugs that players may find temporary workarounds useful. Please refer to the "Temporary Workaround for Some Issues" section for more.

[h1]Development Update[/h1]

- Release Notes

[h2]New Features[/h2]

    ✨ Customers may provide hints about what cards you had wrong.

    ✨ Relevant manual pages will open up automatically when using appraisal tools.

    ✨ Useful links have been added between relevant manual pages to aid navigation.

[h2]Improvements[/h2]

    ❗ A new font now provides better readability. Text is clearer and sharper across multiple resolution and screen ratios.

    ❗ Fixed some save files not showing correctly.

    🎨 Auction entry is not limited to two times per week. Auction biddings have also been tweaked.

    🎨 New/improved events

    🐛 Fixed customers suggesting negative vales.

    🐛 Fixed being able to sell junk to Hanja while it's under repair.

    🐛 Fixed game freezing on a curation event where the customer asks for a stolen good.

    🐛 Fixed some item prices changing on save load.

    🐛 Celebrity types changing mid game now also changes effect of their counterfeit signs.

    🐛 Fixed game freezing on day 16 evening when riding bus.

    ## Known Issues

    ⚠️ Some save files still missing from save select view.

    ⚠️ Bug reporter not being able to send.

    ⚠️ Falling off the plaza elevator.

[h2]Temporary Workaround for Some Issues[/h2]

[h3]Resolution, Text Broken[/h3]

Some machines have their resolution stuck in low setting. This may be fixed by resetting the game setting completely. Please refer to the link below for how.

notes.title: 0.9.0 - Updated Economy, More Ending Contents
notes.content:

notes.title: 0.7.2 Patch Notes and Development Schedule Update
notes.content:
[h2]0.7.2 Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]

❗ An issue where some purchases ending in duplicate items in inventory has been fixed. Cases where presenting one of the duplicate items during curation breaking the game have also been addressed.

🐛 The formula for calculating item sale margin in the display case has been fixed.

We plan to improve game sound, and more importantly make improvmenets to the game ending sequences.

Hoochoo Game Studios.

notes.title: Version 6.0: Now on the Main Branch
notes.content:
Hoochoo Game Studios brings you news on the update 0.6.

Update 0.6, which was available only in beta, is now live!

This update introduces the "Reputation" of your store that you must keep in check. Also, you may "Rent" out items to customers in as a new way to raise profit.

Check out the details about these new mechanisms in our previous post about the 0.6 beta.

[h3]- Reputation[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37932204/f881ceeac1bd4e7e616d172c7b07d67269c51261.png[/img]

[h3]- Rental Service[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37932204/976e7543f046a5ecd4d167d4580b7a0067b26860.gif[/img]

[h2]Message from the developers[/h2]

First of all, we'd like to thank all the players who have joined us in the beta branch, giving valuable feedback as well as bug reports.

We would also like to apologize sincerely for the players who have encountered critical bugs or grew weary of some repetition in late gameplay.

We are trying to streamline the QA pipeline so that all critical bugs can be addressed ahead of release. We are also working on a bug reporter and debugger so that we can address issues faster and with more accuracy.

We have also added late game mechanics to mitigate the repetitiveness of late game gameplay, and will contine to explore measures to help further fix this issue.

Finally, a lot of player feedback expressed dissapointment in the endings of the game being too short and sudden. The current endings don't include all of our planned content, and will be polished much more. We will strive to deliver satisfactory endings to you in the final release.

Thank you.

notes.title: 0.6.0 Beta Release
notes.content:
[h2]We are launching the 0.6.0 update to the beta branch![/h2]

In this update, we introduce the last pieces of the game mechanic, "Reputation" and "Rent". The remaining fifteen days of story and all endings are also included in this update.

[h3]Reputation[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37932204/f881ceeac1bd4e7e616d172c7b07d67269c51261.png[/img]
The reputation of your store is represented with these three cards. Actions you take during the course of the game will improve or degrade each of these cards, and customers will respond to such change accordingly.

[h3]대여[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37932204/976e7543f046a5ecd4d167d4580b7a0067b26860.gif[/img]
New types of customers will look to borrow items from your show window for a fee. The rent income might be tempting, but beware as sometimes customers may damage or lose items.


This 0.6.0 update has been focused on putting all the mechanism and volume out there. There are many shortcomings in terms of technical, user experience, and balancing issues. Therefore, we decided to publish to a beta branch first so players who want a more polished experience can choose not to update for the time being. Please consider this patch as our show of gratitude for the response and feedback from all of you, who are helping so much to shape this game into fruition.


[h3]How to join the beta[/h3]
1. Right click "No Umbrellas Allowed" and select "Properties..."
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37932204/fcfd0dfbdfa53ed239a36a33c4f0d93708ad51ff.png[/img]

2. Move to "BETAS" tab and write down the code "screaminggoats" into the "beta access code..." field and click "CHECK CODE"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37932204/238af0092d494ed86977a63ac27948147f17616f.png[/img]

3. In the "Select the beta~" dropdown, select "beta-". You should see a message like "Successfully opted into~". Now enjoy!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37932204/50a2abb12b072aead2fd28b18ca1b71a6c45ae26.png[/img]

We apologize sincerely once again for the delay of the official launch. We will strive as ever to deliver the polished, fun experience in the final product.

Thank you.

notes.title: 0.6.0 update notice
notes.content:
We'd like to share news about the coming 0.6.0 and full release!

The upcoming 0.6.0 will be the last major update before the full release. The 0.6.0 update will feature new mechanisms "Reputation" and "Rent". Most importantly, 0.6.0 will feature extended gameplay to day 40 and all endings. After this update, we will focus on final polish of the game rather than adding new mechanisms.

Thanks to the community feedback and support, we've had the chance to understand how you feel about the game and improve the design of both storytelling and gameplay. We are finally ready to show you the endgame!

However, 0.6.0 will initially launch on our beta branch on October 30th. We will provide instructions on how to participate in the beta branch after the update. This major update is so big in volume that our quality assurance efforts was not able to cover the update throughly in time. Knowing that this is a very important update that will represent the final form of the game, we decided to first disclose the content on beta branch until it is stable enough.

Meanwhile, the final release of the game has been postponed to November. We apologize sincerely for keeping you waiting. Even after the roadmap announcement, we decided to add more and more content to improve the game. We'd like to thank everyone for bearing with us patiently. We are doing our best to deliver our game with quality and stability in the final release.

Thank you.

notes.title: 0.5.0 Update
notes.content:
<No Umbrellas Allowed> Version 0.5.0 is finally ready!

With this update, we’re adding eight neighboring stores that will stimulate your purchasing desire and make your store operations more diverse. Visit the stores and invest in yourself with the money you earn at Darcy’s!

For example, if your economic situation gets worse, try the Auction House. From there, you can make a killing with a single item. However, don’t ever try to fool the auctioneer. She always eventually finds out the real value of your items. She can even give you a penalty. To avoid the penalty, it is very important to carefully appraise the items at the start.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37932204/7bff1a3a176bf74ffc136af37ed5d9567705c730.gif[/img]

Yes, Ajik City is where ‘Avarice’ is not allowed. But, it doesn’t mean you have to make yourself look boring. There are two shops waiting for Floaties who were born to be fashion-conscious.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37932204/2ff9cab06674d91c60390a04e0d0646d00bfaa99.gif[/img]

They say information is a powerful weapon. It’s time to say good-bye to the days you just sit and listen to what customers come to tell you. Visit the new Citizen Discourse Data shop and catch on to what's going on in the city. By this, you can become a manager who's got a quick ear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37932204/92a4ce0ef209564d515f9854bfb9ed9ac9f91b97.gif[/img]

Besides, you can visit other shops to buy flowers, to fix or resell the items you bought, and to buy a house. Or just stop by Jane Kim's jewelry shop to say hello. But, all these stores are closed exactly at the same time as you. So make sure to visit them in the morning.

Last but not least, version 0.5.0 also includes a series of missions that will make your gameplay more challenging. With this, the overall economic system and balancing will continue to improve until the official launch.

The 0.6.0 version, which will be released in late October, will include the stories of the remaining 15 days and several Achievements. Until the official launch, we will keep our best to make a high-quality game. Thank you!

notes.title: 0.5.0 - The Street Stores Update
notes.content:
This coming September 25th, <No Umbrellas Allowed> will be released in version 0.5.0!

- New Features

    As announced at the time of the 0.4.0 release, nine neighbor stores will be available in the 0.5.0 patch. Visit 9 neighbor stores on your way to work, including a repair shop and a flower shop!

    In addition, the overall economic system has been refined for more challenging gameplay.

    - Quests are given to motivate them to raise money.
    - Improve product prices and card effectiveness with smooth gameplay.

    The economic system will continue to improve until the official launch.

- Version 0.6.0 Preview: Full Story Open & 'Reputation' Cards

    Version 0.6.0 will be the last version to be released before the official launch. With it, we'd like to open the whole story and add our new concept of 'Reputation'. Also, it will reveal all the functional areas except for visual improvements.

    - 'Reputation' Cards?

        Every choice you make affects your overall gameplay. But with just qualitative feedbacks—which used to be our primary way, it's hard for the player to feel the change. And we thought it is hard to be called a good game design when it forces players to experience the change of gameplay with harsh, merciless feedback. Instead, we've decided to choose a more direct and explicit way.

        So, from now on, all of the things that were "appraised" and "recommended" by Darcy's will be tagged with cards called [Appraised by Darcy's] or [Recommended by Darcy's]. The effect of each card will be minimal at the start, but it will get stronger depending on the player's effort. For example, if the player continues to recommend good things, the card [Recommended by Darcy's] will soon work as a strong appeal to the customer.

        We are hoping this will ultimately make players enjoy the feeling of growing their stores.

    The 0.6.0 version was originally planned to be released within September, but sadly it will be delayed from late September to mid-October. It is due to the delay in translation work, and the introduction of the new function we just mentioned. However, we'd like to let you know we will do our best until the end to make a perfect game. Thank you!

notes.title: 0.4.0 - The Avarice Criminal Report Update

notes.title: About the upcoming 0.4 update
notes.content:
Hello to all Early Access participants! Check out what is coming in the 0.4 update, about to ship.

[h2]New gameplay mechanic - Avarice crime report[/h2]

As we mentioned in the roadmap announcement post, we felt the need for the player to be able to get engaged more in the story. We looked into ways the player can influence the world.

- We want the fixer to be feared more.

    The talks about the "fixer" may have sparked interest for players, but its prospect was not very threating. The AVAC will now try to rain down the fixer more early in the game.

- The AVAC announces they will use "fixerain" unless the people of the Ajik city behave.

    The AVAC hands out buttons that the people of Ajik city to report each other for their avarice crime. The whole city is challenged to sort out certain number of avarice criminals or suffer the consequences in the form of fixerain doom. Will this policy make the people turn on each other? Or will it make the people unite against AVAC? Maybe, the buttons will just be used to get done with personal feuds.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37932204/d5ec1b53dc2bdf6db5854ab08aff694614fc8a6d.gif[/img]

- The policy change will affect the people you meet.

    We have added some new customer behaviors that reflect these changes so that the story can be more dramatically delivered.

[h2]Revoked save file compatibility[/h2]

With this update, previous saves players may have had after day 6 will be disabled. Saves from day 7 or later will not be able to load.

The player feedback from the Early Access so far have got us to realize that big changes - larger than that we previously planned - were needed in order for the game to get better. We have made the difficult decision to revoke some save file compatibility, and instead create room for the gameplay and story to change a lot more.

We sincerely apologize to the players who have been looking forward to continue the game with their latest save from day 25. We have taken great care to make the gameplay better and refreshed the story so that this change would not mean playing the same game over from start again, but be closer to playing a changed, interesting new version of the game. Save file compatibility for saves before day 5 will be maintained, as there are no major changes from the previous version during those play times.

[h2]The next update[/h2]

Although they have not been included with the upcoming 0.4 version, there are plenty more features we are looking to introduce based on player feedback. In version 0.5, players will be able to enter other stores in the street and buy various items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37932204/da9063c7d45fb07de9f2b8daf518f951d8244e60.gif[/img]
With the 0.4 update, we will provide more detail regarding the 0.5 update.

A more detailed development roadmap can be found in our previous post.

Thank you.

notes.title: Road Map and Delay of Official Release
notes.content:
Hi, this is Hoochoo Game Studios.

It's already been 2 weeks since our studio released No Umbrellas Allowed through early access. Over the past 2 weeks, our studio has been able to hear your feedback and find many improvements. Also, we were able to experience a variety of things that you are looking forward to in the game. Among them, there were two things our team members agree to be supplemented.

First of all, we felt the need for a major improvement on the way to and from work. The original commuting route was designed to help you immerse yourself in the world and use it to run the store. But we also felt that the current level of the route is not achieving that goal. So we've decided to add features to eight stores nearby the store and let you visit each of them. Each store will complement the functional limitations of Darcy's or help you operate the store better. For example,

- Auction House: It's a place that you can have another chance to sell the items that seem to have deeper story and value in a higher price.

- Flower shop: Here you can buy flowers that can make a positive difference to your customers.

- Citizen Discourse Data Store: All conversations in the city are recorded in Citizens Discourse Data. We will use various rumors in the data as quests.

Next, we would like to give the player more chance to control the story. In other words, the main character in the game will have a greater impact on the world and we will show it in a more direct way. In the new story, the Association of Victims of Avarice Crimes sets the number of Avarice criminals the citizens have to search every week. If the citizens fail, the Association will drop the Fixerain. In the fear of the Fixerain, you can report some of your customers who seem greedy. However, it is not easy to press the Report Button without a hitch. This is because not only the reported but also all citizens will begin to get wary of you from the moment you are announced to the whole city as an excellent reporter.

The Early Access period of No Umbrellas Allowed will be a little longer to include these two new functions in the game. However, we changed our plan to open the story of the 26-40th day during the Early Access period, which we promised to open with an official release. Our schedule is as below, and as always, we are going to keep distributing the updated version including bug fixes. Thank you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37932204/87ed3411b92383abfa14ea2c19db4e20d11b0072.png[/img]

notes.title: 0.2.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
No Umbrellas Allowed is participating in the Steam Game Festival, Summer Edition. We focused our efforts to mitigating critical bugs during the three days long demo that can ruin the gameplay experience.

- Release Notes

    [h2]Known Issues in 0.2.5[/h2]

    ⚠️ Save&Loading the game will remove calendar entries.

    ⚠️ Street interactions no longer available will still show up as interactable.

    ⚠️ Some manual pages are not unlocked as intended.

    [h2]Improvements[/h2]

    ❗ Fixed a critical issue where player choice events freeze game.

    🎨 Game intro sequence improvements

    🎨 Some awkward background music transitions have been improved.

    🐛 Fixed an issue where players are sent back to the street after game endings.

    🐛 Fixed an issue where items with no content text display "No translation found for~" as their content text.

    🐛 Fixed an issue where street or store became suddenly visible for few days before the next day prompt.

    🐛 Fixed an issue where a certain manual page was missing.

    🐛 Fixed an issue where loan interest and loan status was not showing correct values.

    🐛 Added translation for loan related texts.

    🐛 Selecting an inventory item will now stop trigger overlapping card insert sounds.

    🐛 Customers looking to buy also use their facial expression now.

    🐛 Fixed a case where a tier 2 card that is supposed to cancel out a tier 1 card did not behave as designed.

notes.title: 0.2.2 Release
notes.content:
Headed towards Early Access and Steam Summer Game Festival, We focused on improving general gameplay, as well as polishing intro quality and adding sound effects

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37932204/b520ad65b6dde0cc1da9f5ce973e4c9fc2985833.png[/img]

✨ Language, screen resolution, window mode, and volume settings have been added.

✨ A short cutscene of Bob falling asleep has been added.

✨ A new dialogue sound effect has been added.

✨ Language selection has been enabled! English is supported only to Day 3 at the moment. From day 4, all content is machine translated at the moment. Full English support is on its way.

[h2]Improvements[/h2]

🎨 Game intro cutscenes have been improved.

🎨 Added more variety to customer reactions in various situations.

🐛 Fixed broken behavior of the jewel inspection tool.

🐛 Fixed weird mouse click position offset in MacOS

🐛 Fixed some street character animations playing very fast and not playing through to the end.

🐛 Fixed some street character animations not starting in default pose.

🐛 Fixed some UI element sounds playing too loudly.

🐛 Fixed items displaying wrong content text, misleadingly implying wrong brand affinity.

🐛 Fixed player choice dialogue buttons appearing on top of the settings window.

🐛 Prevented negative store balance from creating negative loan offers.

🐛 Some manual text have been improved to clear ambiguities.

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]

⚠️ Street choice event break game

⚠️ Some street interactions keep showing up as interactable even after all interactions have been exhausted

⚠️  Wrong camera behavior just before next day prompt animation

⚠️ Manual pages sometimes do not unlock as they should
